arStrings.szText: Craft Horadric Jewels and expand the breadth of your power.
Reach {c_important}Horadric Knowledge Rank 18{/c} at the {icon:Marker_Reputation_Season, 2.5} {c_highlight}Horadric Focus{/c}
Craft a {c_important}Horadric Jewel{/c} at the {icon:Marker_Reputation_Season, 2} {c_highlight}Horadric Lapidary{/c}
Exchange {icon:Icons_HoradricPower_Currency, 2} {c_pickups}Horadric Phials{/c} for {c_important}Horadric Knowledge{/c} at the {icon:Marker_Reputation_Season, 2.5} {c_highlight}Horadric Lapidary{/c}
